evidence.title: $TCP_α$: Margin-Controlled Confidence estimation for reliable Music Information Retrieval

summary: A new margin-controlled confidence estimation method called TCP_alpha has been developed to improve reliability in Music Information Retrieval (MIR) models. The framework addresses uncertainty quantification to help systems produce more dependable confidence scores across audio and music processing tasks.
title: Researchers Introduce TCP_alpha to Enhance Confidence Estimation in Music Information Retrieval
